business_problem: Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank needed to replace repeated IT construction, weak customer insight, limited digital marketing, and uneven risk capabilities with a reusable technology foundation for retail and inclusive-finance growth.
solution_summary: Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank used Tencent Cloud to execute a broad retail-banking digital-transformation program instead of layering new channels onto fragmented legacy systems. Tencent designed a three-layer architecture: a channel layer for mobile banking, WeChat banking, video banking, marketing tools, and mobile work portals; a middle layer for channel, data, and intelligence capabilities; and a cloud foundation built on big data, PaaS, and IaaS. The bank then mapped those shared services into customer engagement, online marketing, community expansion, risk identification, remote video service, and small-business lending. Supporting products such as TSF, CKafka, TDMQ, and Redis provide microservice governance, messaging, and low-latency data access for the platform. The result is a reusable digital foundation that connects customer-facing innovation, data-driven marketing, and risk management instead of treating them as separate projects.

solution_components.name: Intelligence Middle Office

solution_components.name: Elastic Multi-active Cloud Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the distributed cloud-native base for agile delivery and resilient banking operations.

data_flow: Customer interactions from mobile banking, WeChat banking, video services, and manager tools flow into shared middle-office services, where data and intelligence capabilities support marketing, customer insight, remote service, and risk workflows before being delivered back to front-line channels and staff tools.
business_outcome: The bank gained a shared platform for digital retail growth, better customer experience, stronger community and manager tools, and a more agile technical base for ongoing innovation.
architecture_clues: The architecture is explicitly organized into channel, middle-office, and cloud-foundation layers.
The cloud foundation combines big data, PaaS, and IaaS services.
TSF, CKafka, TDMQ, and Redis are part of the technical foundation exposed in the related product list.
